The sales price from the sale of wind energy conversion property or hydroelectricity conversion property to be used as an electric power source and the sale of the materials used to manufacture, install, or construct wind energy conversion property or hydroelectricity conversion property used or to be used as an electric power source.

utility_pv.quote: 90. The sales price from the sale of solar energy equipment. For purposes of this subsection, "solar energy equipment" means equipment that is primarily used to collect and convert incident solar radiation into thermal, mechanical, or electrical energy or equipment that is primarily used to transform such converted solar energy to a storage point or to a point of use.
utility_pv.arithmetic: JEDI's utility PV taxable base is its materials and equipment, 0.642105 of the cost: mounting 0.105263, modules 0.368421, electrical 0.105263, inverter 0.063158. The modules (collect and convert) and the inverter (transform to a point of use) are the equipment the subsection names: (0.368421 + 0.063158) / 0.642105 = 0.672131 of the tax. Mounting and electrical materials are not named, so their tax stays.
utility_pv.ruling: Whether Iowa's solar exemption reaches racking and wiring is a reading of the statute: default, it does not (67.2 percent of the tax exempt).

land_based_wind.tip: Mississippi taxes manufacturing machinery used directly in manufacturing at 1.5 percent rather than 7, and manufacturing includes the generation of electricity (Administrative Code Title 35, Part IV, 7.03.101 and 7.03.202); construction materials and the rest of a contract pay the contractor's tax: (7 - 1.5) / 7.06 = 77.9 percent of the tax on the machinery; the tool holds the turbines and blades, (193,738,619 + 45,356,867) / 357,201,093 = 66.9 percent of JEDI's taxable purchases: 52.1 percent, so the tax shown is an upper bound.
land_based_wind.quote: "Manufacturing" refines, improves, changes the condition of raw materials, or converts the form of the materials into new, different, or more useful property and includes the fabrication or production of special made-to-order articles and the generation of electricity.

utility_pv.tip: Mississippi taxes manufacturing machinery used directly in manufacturing at 1.5 percent rather than 7, and manufacturing includes the generation of electricity (Administrative Code Title 35, Part IV, 7.03.101 and 7.03.202); construction materials and the rest of a contract pay the contractor's tax: (7 - 1.5) / 7.06 = 77.9 percent of the tax on the machinery; the tool holds the modules and inverters, (0.368421 + 0.063158) / 0.642105 = 67.2 percent of JEDI's taxable purchases: 52.4 percent, so the tax shown is an upper bound.
utility_pv.quote: "Manufacturing" refines, improves, changes the condition of raw materials, or converts the form of the materials into new, different, or more useful property and includes the fabrication or production of special made-to-order articles and the generation of electricity.
